interface.signature: def build_bridges(str1: str, str2: str) -> int:

preconditions.description: The lengths of str1 and str2 must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'*', '#', '@'} for c in str1) and all(c in {'*', '#', '@'} for c in str2)
preconditions.description: All characters in both strings must be one of '*', '#', or '@'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max([len(indices) for indices in get_valid_non_crossing_pairs(str1, str2)])
postconditions.description: The return value is the maximum number of non-crossing bridges, where a bridge connects str1[i] and str2[j] if str1[i] == str2[j], and for any two bridges (i1, j1) and (i2, j2) with i1 < i2, it must hold that j1 < j2.

helper_definitions.get_valid_non_crossing_pairs: A function that returns a list of all valid sequences of indices (i1, j1), (i2, j2), ... such that str1[ik] == str2[jk] for all k, and if ik < il then jk < jl. This represents all possible non-crossing bridge configurations.
